description: Eight independent gate re-timers: each input's rises and falls are held back until the master clock at the top rises or falls, so eight loose gates all change together

params.text: Cycles the window in which a queued change is allowed through, 1 millisecond, 16 milliseconds and then 64 milliseconds; the lamp reads green, yellow and red in that order

inputs.text: A gate or trigger to be re-timed; its rise is held until the master clock next rises and its fall until the master clock next falls
The master clock or gate whose rises and falls every channel is lined up with

outputs.text: The re-timed gate for that row, 10V while held high and 0V while held low

notes: An empty input row is treated as permanently falling, so its output is pulled low at the next fall of the master clock and stays there
Only the master jack is named in the source, so the eight row inputs and the eight row outputs show no tooltip of their own
